records.title: OpenTTD
records.setupBurden: Install official release and download free OpenGFX base graphics on first run; optional OpenSFX/OpenMSX.
caveats: Original paid Transport Tycoon Deluxe files are optional, not required: use free base assets.

records.title: SuperTuxKart
records.setupBurden: Download official stable release; no compiler needed.
caveats: Official Oct 24 2026 notice says addons site was taken offline for security risks. Do not promise working online addons or conflate in-development Evolution with the stable download.

records.title: Beyond All Reason
records.setupBurden: Higher: launcher followed by asset updates; 12 GB RAM minimum; SSD advised.
caveats: Online play requires account with valid email.
Recommend 20 GB available space per official guide; not instant browser play.

records.title: Xonotic
records.setupBurden: Download and extract official package; project says no installation needed.
caveats: Editorial choice; no verified comparable aggregate player rating.

records.title: VoxeLibre
records.setupBurden: Two-step: install Luanti, then install VoxeLibre game through its content system.
caveats: Luanti is the engine, not the same game: feature VoxeLibre explicitly.
